newsitem.title: USA: Tropical storm threatens ships in Philippine Sea.
newsitem.headline: Tropical storm threatens ships in Philippine Sea.

text.p: Tropical Storm Opal is strengthening in the eastern Philippine Sea and will become a threat to shipping, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Monday.
Opal has 40 mph winds and is nearly stationary near 15.4n/132.7e.
It will intensify to a typhoon with 80 mph winds within 48 hours. Opal will begin a slow north-northwest movement during this period, WSC added.
